title: In GTA 6, Robbing a Store Together Counts as a Date 💘 #Shorts
description:
New details from The Guardian's GTA 6 preview with Rockstar North (as reported by VICE and RockstarINTEL, Nov 14, 2026): Jason and Lucia have a relationship system. They can call and text when apart and go on dates when together, like the gym or a drink. A liquor store robbery can also count as a date, there's a button to hold hands, and the relationship can decline if you neglect it.

Sources: The Guardian preview via VICE (vice.com) and RockstarINTEL. Images: official Grand Theft Auto VI trailers (Rockstar Games).

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
